item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"allocated_blocks","expression":"sum(len(group) for group in self.kv_cache_manager.get_blocks(request.request_id).blocks) if not delay_free_blocks else 0","rationale":"Block release traverses the request's allocated KV blocks, making their count a direct predictor of cleanup work."},{"name":"last_reference_blocks","expression":"sum(block.ref_cnt == 1 for group in self.kv_cache_manager.get_blocks(request.request_id).blocks for block in group) if not delay_free_blocks else 0","rationale":"Blocks losing their final reference require free-pool insertion; shared prefix blocks remain referenced and incur less work."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is approximately a fixed request-cleanup cost plus costs proportional to allocated blocks and blocks whose final reference is released."}
